GitHub - tarudesu/ViHateT5: Repository for the paper "ViHateT5: Enhancing Hate Speech Detection in Vietnamese with A Unified Text-to-Text Transformer Model" (ACL'2024 - Findings)
The VOZ-HSD dataset consists of 10.7M+ AI-annotated comments with two labels HATE (1) and CLEAN (0) from Vietnamese users' comments on VOZ Forum.
